blocks.text: Spacious and quality laptop tote bag with lots of pocket organizers From TanTo, a leading functional tote bag brand . Fashion and functional design, quality materials, excellent workmanship . 8+ years experiences in designing and manufacturing functional bags Roomy computer tote bag Size of this purse is 44cm/17.3in * 15cm/5.9in * 33cm/13in (L*W*H). It fits laptop, laptop accessories (charger cord & mouse), writing utensils, planner, small files and more Multiple sections and pockets 3 pen holders 2 zipper pockets (1 outside and 1 inside ) 2 mesh pockets 1 water bottle/umbrella holder 8 inside holders Built-in USB Port USB port is built-in on outside of the bag, charge your cell phones easily( Power bank is not included ) Detachable shoulder Pad Thick and wide shoulder pad is included to reduce burden from your shouder/hand Solid designed and well made This laptop purse is made of high quality materials. It's durable ,water resistant and easy to clean Unrivaled Quality Designed and built with high quality fabric, zipper and excellent workmanshipPackage contains: 1x laptop tote bag with multiple pockets inside 1x Shoulder strap

items: Crafted from nylon & PU leather, a slight odor may exist when first opened due to new materials—normal and will fade in 48-72 hours with ventilation. For faster removal, place in a well-ventilated area or use activated charcoal.

items.label: LARGE AND SPACIOUS LAPTOP TOTE
items.value: This laptop tote bag is large and spacious. There are two main compartments inside. One section is for laptop, where velcro strap is attached to secure your computer in place. The other compartment can hold almost everything you need for work such as umbrella, drink bottle, purse, day planner, keys and small carryall. It's a large professional bag.

items.label: ORGANIZER PURSE
items.value: It's a powerful functional laptop tote bag with tons of pocket to separate your stuff. Also a string holding keys is attached to make sure keys are always easy to reach. Everything is well organized with one sleek laptop purse.

items.label: USB PORT DESIGN
items.value: With built in USB interface, it's convenient to charge your phone or other electronic devices while keeping your power bank inside of the bag （Power bank is not included)

items.label: RICH CARRYING METHODS
items.value: It can be used as a handbag, messenger bag, shoulder bag. It can also be connected to a trolley for easy carrying.

items.label: QUALITY MATERIALS
items.value: Laptop bag is made of quality fabric,durable .Water-Resistant Exterior – Shields against light rain and splashes.Smooth zipper,the carryall bag can be opened and closed smoothly. Inside dividers are wrapped with thick pad to make sure your computer is well protected.
